name: Stygian-Hamada
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in a subterranean ocean. Travelers navigate by massive canyon systems and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Surveyors date the derelict space station in orbit to before the region's last cataclysm, which should be impossible. The structures are unweathered, as if time skipped this place.
For traders, water, iron and rare flora alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
